verdict.rationale: The only robots.txt probe on a Secretary of State host (bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov) returned HTTP 200, but the response was a bot-management SPA shell with no robots directives, so it is not a real, readable robots.txt. No evidence shows a genuine robots.txt on www.sos.ca.gov, and the Franchise Tax Board probe concerns a different agency, so it was not considered.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
